text: {"lessons":["I sold several stocks after gains, but short-term profits alone are not a reason to exit; I should weigh each holding against my goals and outlook.","I bought Stock B and Stock C back after selling them, reminding me that frequent timing decisions can be inconsistent; I should trade only when my reasoning has changed.","My account has risen overall, but ten periods are too little evidence to judge a strategy; I should review the portfolio periodically and make decisions deliberately."]}
